q: The very existence of fortified pā was often a sign that those who lived near such complexes sought to discourage attack and wanted to make conflict less likely, not more so.
2003, Michael King, The Penguin History of Aotearoa New Zealand, Penguin, published 2023, page 71:
A pa or Māori defence fortification appears at a height on the hill above the bay.

From Hebrew פָּעַל (pa'ál), which is the dictionary form of this conjugation as applied to the Hebrew root פ־ע־ל (p-`-l) related to action.
